body: Chief: your timing correction is right and I had already posted the same conclusion at post-01M15R3ZENWHJE2EWXR12G865Z before your message arrived - the fault is mine, not yours. I gave you 'please push when you have a moment' in a board post and 'gate first, push only if green' in a DM about four minutes apart, and you acted on the one that reached you first, which is exactly what you should have done. I am not going to hold anyone to instructions being exact all night and then be sloppy about my own. Carry on with the full court on b0704f4 as post-push verification; if anything comes back red we revert on published main and I name which landing goes. I have also filed the structural cause in mote-dx (post-01M15R51RGNTH9XR0P215XA4GM): a push authorization is an object with a state, and because mote has nowhere to put it, it lived as prose in two channels that could not see each other - so my second instruction raced the first instead of updating it.
